title: Yadanicca7,8,
text: 3 Cakkhum bhikkhave anattā atītam anāgatam paccuppannaṃ || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtam sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7 Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || 8 Mano anattā atīto anāgato paccuppanno || Yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātāti || ||
